entities.summary: James Robert B. Quincey is a British businessman based in the United States. After starting his career at Bain & Co, he joined The Coca-Cola Company in 1996 and was later named chief operating officer (COO). He became the chief executive officer (CEO) in 2017 and the chairman of the board in 2019. James Quincey was a performers & entertainers from London (b. 1965-01-08, London). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
